title: Procurement of 25KVA Servo Voltage Stabilizers for Audio Video Project at Aguada Lighthouse and DGNSS Station under Goa Directorate
summary: GeM bid for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of three 25 kVA single-phase servo voltage stabilizers at Aguada Lighthouse and DGPS Station, Goa, for the audio-video project (Goa Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Aguada Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Post Condolim, Sinquerim, Mapusa, Goa 403515
sites.work: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 3 sets 25 kVA servo voltage stabilizers

money.notes: EMD advisory bank SBI, beneficiary Director, DLL Goa; MSE manufacturer EMD exemption per GeM GTC. 80% of product cost payable on delivery, minimum 20% allocated to installation, commissioning and testing (10 days after site readiness). MII and MSE purchase preference enabled. Option clause +/-25%. Estimated bid value not printed.

period.completion: 15 days delivery; ICT within 10 days of site readiness
period.warranty: 3 years from final acceptance/commissioning; OEM warranty certificate required

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 6 lakh; OEM average turnover: Rs 49 lakh
3 years past experience supplying same/similar category products to Central/State Govt/PSU
Past performance: 30% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years
MSE and DPIIT startup exemption from experience and turnover: Yes
Only Class-I/Class-II local suppliers; minimum local content 50% (Class 1) / 20% (Class 2)
Dedicated/toll-free service number, escalation matrix, functional service centre in consignee state (or within 30 days of award)
specs: 25 kVA single phase servo voltage stabilizer; GeM category Servo Control Drive - Servo Motor Operated LVC as per IS 9815 (Part 1)
Material test certificate with supply; buyer lab test results sole acceptance criterion
notes: GeM bid dated 23-05-2025; bid end 13-06-2025 19:00, opening 19:30; pre-bid 02-06-2025 15:00 at DLL Goa, Deep Bhavan, Bambolim. Two-packet bid, total value evaluation, no reverse auction. Consignee is Assistant Engineer (E), Aguada Lighthouse & DGPS Station; consignee's personal name and mobile number, and buyer's individual e-mail, not transcribed ([personal contact removed]).
